caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: The figure contains three pie charts summarizing the distribution of quantifier and operation categories for three task groupings: “Categorical,” “Approximate Number Generation,” and “Disjunctive & Conjunctive.” The Categorical pie chart shows 4 slices with percentage labels inside: “Universal Quantifiers” in light blue at 29.07%, “Limiter” in light pink at 27.91%, “Negation” in light orange at 27.91%, and “Existential Quantifiers” in light green at 15.12%; no legend is shown and no slice is exploded. The Approximate Number Generation pie chart shows 3 slices with internal percentage labels: “Approximate Quantities” in pale yellow at 45.03%, “Comparative Relationships” in light blue at 36.26%, and “Absolute Absence” in light lavender at 18.71%; there is no legend and no visual emphasis beyond labeling. The Disjunctive & Conjunctive pie chart shows 2 slices with internal percentage labels: “Disjunctive” in very light bluish-gray at 49.51% and “Conjunctive” in very light pinkish-gray at 50.49%; it also has no legend, and the slices appear nearly evenly split without any offset or explosion.
